256                //populateStations(ships);
257                populateShipSystems(shipSystems, ships);

285                linkRelatedEntries();

299        public static void addUnknownEntry() {
300                ROOT.addChild(new CodexEntryV2(UNKNOWN_ENTRY_ID, 
301                                "UNKNOWN ENTRY", null, UNKNOWN_ENTRY_ID) {
302                        @Override
303                        public void createTitleForList(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, ListMode mode) {
304                                info.addPara("UNKNOWN ENTRY", Misc.getBasePlayerColor(), 0f);
305                        }
306                        @Override
307                        public boolean isVisible() {
308                                return false;
309                        }
310                        @Override
311                        public boolean isLocked() {
312                                return false;
313                        }
314                        @Override
315                        public boolean hasCustomDetailPanel() {
316                                return true;
317                        }
318                        @Override
319                        public void createCustomDetail(CustomPanelAPI panel, UIPanelAPI relatedEntries, CodexDialogAPI codex) {
320                                float opad = 10f;
321                                float width = panel.getPosition().getWidth();
322                                float horzBoxPad = 30f;
323                                // the right width for a tooltip wrapped in a box to fit next to relatedEntries
324                                float tw = width - 290f - opad - horzBoxPad + 10f;
325                                
326                                TooltipMakerAPI text = panel.createUIElement(tw, 0, false);
327                                text.setParaSmallInsignia();
328                                text.addPara("UNKNOWN ENTRY\n\nPlease register your Tri-Tachyon datapad to receive the latest news and updates.", 0f);
329                                panel.updateUIElementSizeAndMakeItProcessInput(text);
330                                UIPanelAPI box = panel.wrapTooltipWithBox(text);
331                                panel.addComponent(box).inTL(0f, 0f);
332                                if (relatedEntries != null) {
333                                        panel.addComponent(relatedEntries).inTR(0f, 0f);
334                                }
335                                
336                                float height = box.getPosition().getHeight();
337                                if (relatedEntries != null) {
338                                        height = Math.max(height, relatedEntries.getPosition().getHeight());
339                                }
340                        }                       
341                });             
342        }

344        public static void addCustomCodexEntryDetailPanelExample() {
345                if (Global.getSettings().isDevMode() && !Global.getSettings().getBoolean("playtestingMode")) {
346                        CodexEntryPlugin custom = createCustomExampleCategory();
347                        ROOT.addChild(custom);
348                        
349                        CodexCustomEntryExample entry = new CodexCustomEntryExample("custom_example_1", 
350                                                                                "Custom detail example", getIcon(CAT_CUSTOM_EXAMPLE));
351                        entry.setParam("Has to be set to something for detail to show; "
352                                        + "usually this is the data for what the entry is about");
353                        // or, can set it to a fighter wing/hull/weapon spec to get a custom icon
354                        entry.setParam(Global.getSettings().getHullSpec("paragon"));
355                        custom.addChild(entry);
356                        entry.addRelatedEntry(getEntry(getHullmodEntryId(HullMods.ADVANCED_TARGETING_CORE)));
357                        entry.addRelatedEntry(getEntry(getShipEntryId("onslaught")));
358                        entry.addRelatedEntry(getEntry(getWeaponEntryId("autopulse")));
359                        entry.addRelatedEntry(getEntry(getFighterEntryId("wasp_wing")));
360                }
361        }

363        public static void setCatSort(CodexEntryPlugin root, Set<CodexEntryPlugin> seen) {
364                if (seen == null) seen = new LinkedHashSet<>();
365                if (seen.contains(root)) return;
366                seen.add(root);
367                for (CodexEntryPlugin cat : root.getChildren()) {
368                        if (!cat.isCategory()) continue;
369                        Float sort = CAT_SORT_RELATED_ENTRIES.get(cat.getId());
370                        if (sort == null) sort = 1000f;
371                        cat.setCategorySortTierForRelatedEntries(sort);
372                        setCatSort(cat, seen);
373                }
374        }

376        public static CodexEntryV2 createHullModsCategory() {
377                CodexEntryV2 hullmods = new CodexEntryV2(CAT_HULLMODS, "Hullmods", getIcon(CAT_HULLMODS)) {
378                        @Override
379                        public boolean hasTagDisplay() {
380                                return true;
381                        }
382                        @Override
383                        public void configureTagDisplay(TagDisplayAPI tags) {
384                                CountingMap<String> techs = new CountingMap<String>();
385                                CountingMap<String> types = new CountingMap<String>();
386                                int dmods = 0;
387                                int intrinsic = 0;
388                                int total = 0;
389                                
390                                for (CodexEntryPlugin curr : getChildren()) {
391                                        if (!(curr.getParam() instanceof HullModSpecAPI)) continue;
392                                        if (!curr.isVisible() || curr.isLocked() || curr.skipForTags()) continue;
393                                        HullModSpecAPI spec = (HullModSpecAPI) curr.getParam();
394                                        
395                                        if (spec.hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_DMOD)) {
396                                                dmods++;
397                                        } else if (spec.isHidden()) {
398                                                intrinsic++;
399                                        }
400                                
401                                        techs.add(spec.getManufacturer());
402                                        for (String type : spec.getUITags()) {
403                                                types.add(type);
404                                        }
405                                        total++;
406                                }
407                                
408                                if (dmods > 0) types.add(DMODS, dmods);
409                                if (intrinsic > 0) types.add(INTRINSIC, intrinsic);
410
411                                float opad = 10f;
412                                float pad = 3f;
413                                
414                                tags.beginGroup(false, ALL_TECHS);
415                                List<String> keys = new ArrayList<String>(techs.keySet());
416                                Collections.sort(keys);
417                                for (String tech : keys) {
418                                        tags.addTag(tech, tech, techs.getCount(tech));
419                                }
420                                tags.setTotalOverrideForCurrentGroup(total);
421                                tags.addGroup(0f);
422                                
423                                
424                                tags.beginGroup(false, ALL_TYPES);
425                                keys = new ArrayList<String>(types.keySet());
426                                Collections.sort(keys);
427                                for (String type : keys) {
428                                        tags.addTag(type, type, types.getCount(type));
429                                }
430                                tags.setTotalOverrideForCurrentGroup(total);
431                                tags.addGroup(opad * 1f);
432                                
433                                tags.checkAll();
434                        }
435                        
436                };
437                return hullmods;
438        }

513        public static CodexEntryV2 createIndustriesCategory() {
514                CodexEntryV2 cat = new CodexEntryV2(CAT_INDUSTRIES, "Industries", getIcon(CAT_INDUSTRIES)) {
515                        @Override
516                        public boolean hasTagDisplay() {
517                                return true;
518                        }
519                        @Override
520                        public void configureTagDisplay(TagDisplayAPI tags) {
521                                int industry = 0;
522                                int structure = 0;
523                                int station = 0;
524                                int other = 0;
525                                int total = 0;
526                                for (CodexEntryPlugin curr : getChildren()) {
527                                        if (!curr.isVisible() || curr.isLocked() || curr.skipForTags()) continue;
528                                        if (!(curr.getParam() instanceof IndustrySpecAPI)) continue;
529                                        
530                                        IndustrySpecAPI spec = (IndustrySpecAPI) curr.getParam();
531                                        if (spec.hasTag(Industries.TAG_INDUSTRY)) industry++;
532                                        else if (spec.hasTag(Industries.TAG_STATION)) station++;
533                                        else if (spec.hasTag(Industries.TAG_STRUCTURE)) structure++;
534                                        else other++;
535                                        
536                                        total++;
537                                }
538                                tags.beginGroup(false, ALL_TYPES);
539                                tags.addTag(INDUSTRIES, industry);
540                                tags.addTag(STRUCTURES, structure);
541                                if (station > 0) tags.addTag(STATIONS, station);
542                                if (other > 0) tags.addTag(OTHER, other);
543                                tags.setTotalOverrideForCurrentGroup(total);
544                                tags.addGroup(0f);
545                                
546                                tags.checkAll();
547                        }
548                };
549                return cat;
550        }

564                                for (CodexEntryPlugin curr : getChildren()) {

1080        public static void populateShipsAndStations(CodexEntryPlugin ships, CodexEntryPlugin stations) {
1081                List<ShipHullSpecAPI> shipSpecs = Global.getSettings().getAllShipHullSpecs();
1082                for (final ShipHullSpecAPI spec : shipSpecs) {
1083                        if (spec.getHullSize() == ShipAPI.HullSize.FIGHTER && !spec.hasTag(Tags.SHOW_IN_CODEX_AS_SHIP)) continue;
1084                        if (spec.getHints().contains(ShipTypeHints.HIDE_IN_CODEX)) continue;
1085                        if (spec.hasTag(Tags.HIDE_IN_CODEX)) continue;
1086                        if (spec.isDefaultDHull()) continue;
1087                        if (spec.getHullId().equals("shuttlepod")) continue;
1088                        
1089                        boolean station = spec.getHints().contains(ShipTypeHints.STATION);
1090                        String name = spec.getHullNameWithDashClass();
1091                        String designation = "";
1092                        if (spec.hasDesignation() && !spec.getDesignation().equals(spec.getHullName())) {
1093                                designation = " " + spec.getDesignation().toLowerCase();
1094                        }
1095                        if (station) {
1096                                designation = "";
1097                                name = spec.getHullName();
1098                        }
1099                        CodexEntryV2 curr = new CodexEntryV2(getShipEntryId(spec.getHullId()), 
1100                                spec.getHullNameWithDashClass() + designation, null, spec) {
1101                                        @Override
1102                                        public String getSortTitle() {
1103                                                return spec.getHullName();
1104                                        }
1105                                        @Override
1106                                        public String getSearchString() {
1107                                                if (station) {
1108                                                        return super.getSearchString() + " Station";
1109                                                }
1110                                                return super.getSearchString();
1111                                        }
1112                                        @Override
1113                                        public void createTitleForList(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, ListMode mode) {
1114                                                info.addPara(spec.getHullName(), Misc.getBasePlayerColor(), 0f);
1115                                                if (station) {
1116                                                        if (mode == ListMode.RELATED_ENTRIES) {
1117                                                                info.addPara("Station", Misc.getGrayColor(), 0f);
1118                                                        }
1119                                                } else if (spec.hasDesignation() && !spec.getDesignation().equals(spec.getHullName())) {
1120                                                        info.addPara(Misc.ucFirst(spec.getDesignation().toLowerCase()), Misc.getGrayColor(), 0f);
1121                                                }
1122                                        }
1123
1124                                        @Override
1125                                        public boolean matchesTags(Set<String> tags) {
1126                                                HullSize size = spec.getHullSize();
1127                                                
1128                                                if (station) {
1129//                                                      String sizeTag = STATIONS;
1130//                                                      if (sizeTag != null && !tags.contains(sizeTag)) return false;
1131        
1132                                                        String m = spec.getManufacturer();
1133                                                        if (m != null && !tags.contains(m) && !tags.contains(ALL_TECHS)) return false;
1134                                                        
1135//                                                      if (!tags.contains(ALL_TYPES)) return false;
1136                                                        
1137                                                        return true;
1138                                                }
1139                                                
1140                                                String sizeTag = null;
1141                                                if (size == HullSize.FIGHTER) sizeTag = ALL_SIZES;
1142                                                if (size == HullSize.FRIGATE) sizeTag = FRIGATES;
1143                                                if (size == HullSize.DESTROYER) sizeTag = DESTROYERS;
1144                                                if (size == HullSize.CRUISER) sizeTag = CRUISERS;
1145                                                if (size == HullSize.CAPITAL_SHIP) sizeTag = CAPITALS;
1146                                                
1147                                                if (sizeTag != null && !tags.contains(sizeTag)) return false;
1148

1150                                                boolean phaseCiv = isPhase && spec.isCivilianNonCarrier();
1151                                                if (!phaseCiv && isPhase && !tags.contains(PHASE_SHIPS)) return false;
1152                                                if (!phaseCiv && spec.isCivilianNonCarrier() && !tags.contains(CIVILIAN)) return false;
1153                                                if (phaseCiv && !tags.contains(PHASE_SHIPS) && !tags.contains(CIVILIAN)) return false;
1154                                                
1155                                                if (spec.isCarrier() && !tags.contains(CARRIERS)) return false;
1156                                                
1157                                                boolean combat = !isPhase && !spec.isCarrier() && !spec.isCivilianNonCarrier();
1158                                                if (combat && !tags.contains(COMBAT_SHIPS)) return false;
1159                                                
1160                                                String m = spec.getManufacturer();
1161                                                if (m != null && !tags.contains(m) && !tags.contains(ALL_TECHS)) return false;
1162                                                
1163                                                return true;
1164                                        }

1166                                        @Override
1167                                        public Set<String> getUnlockRelatedTags() {
1168                                                return spec.getTags();
1169                                        }

1172                                        public boolean isUnlockedIfRequiresUnlock() {
1173                                                return SharedUnlockData.get().isPlayerAwareOfShip(spec.getHullId());
1174                                        }
1175                        };
1176                        if (station) {
1177                                stations.addChild(curr);
1178                        } else {
1179                                ships.addChild(curr);
1180                        }
1181                
1182                        String variantId = spec.getHullId() + "_Hull";
1183                        if (spec.getCodexVariantId() != null && !spec.getCodexVariantId().isBlank()) {
1184                                variantId = spec.getCodexVariantId();
1185                        }
1186                        ShipVariantAPI variant = Global.getSettings().getVariant(variantId);
1187                        if (variant != null) {
1188                                CodexEntryPlugin parent = ships;
1189                                if (station) parent = stations;
1190                                
1191                                int relBefore = curr.getRelatedEntries().size();
1192                                List<CodexEntryPlugin> added = addModulesForVariant(variant, true, curr, parent);
1193                                // created entries, or they were already created but just added them as related
1194                                if (!added.isEmpty() || relBefore < curr.getRelatedEntryIds().size()) {
1195                                        FleetMemberAPI member = Global.getSettings().createFleetMember(FleetMemberType.SHIP, variant);
1196                                        curr.setParam2(member);
1197                                }
1198                        }
1199                }

1322        public static List<CodexEntryPlugin> addModulesForVariant(ShipVariantAPI variant, boolean isEmptyHull,
1323                                                                                        CodexEntryPlugin entry, CodexEntryPlugin parent) {
1324                List<CodexEntryPlugin> result = new ArrayList<>();              
1325                Set<String> seenVariants = new HashSet<>();
1326                for (String slotId : variant.getStationModules().keySet()) {
1327                        ShipVariantAPI moduleVariant = variant.getModuleVariant(slotId);
1328                        if (moduleVariant == null) continue;
1329                        if (moduleVariant.hasHullMod(HullMods.VASTBULK)) continue;
1330
1331                        String moduleEntryId = getShipEntryId(moduleVariant.getHullSpec().getHullId());
1332                        if (isEmptyHull) {
1333                                if (SEEN_STATION_MODULES.containsKey(moduleEntryId) || ENTRIES.containsKey(moduleEntryId)) {
1334                                        makeRelated(entry, SEEN_STATION_MODULES.get(moduleEntryId));
1335                                        continue;
1336                                }
1337                        } else {
1338                                // we're adding an entry for a specific fleet member's variant of the station
1339                                // so, want to add all the modules as fleetmember entries
1340                                // except for ones with duplicate variants
1341                                try {
1342                                        String test = moduleVariant.toJSONObject().toString(4);
1343                                        if (seenVariants.contains(test)) continue;
1344                                        seenVariants.add(test);
1345                                } catch (JSONException e) {
1346                                }
1347                        }
1348                        
1349                        FleetMemberAPI moduleMember = Global.getSettings().createFleetMember(FleetMemberType.SHIP, moduleVariant);
1350                        //if (moduleMember.getVariant().getFittedWeaponSlots().isEmpty()) continue;
1351                        CodexEntryPlugin module = addModuleEntry(parent, entry, moduleMember, isEmptyHull);
1352                        SEEN_STATION_MODULES.put(moduleEntryId, module);
1353                        
1354                        makeRelated(entry, module);
1355                        result.add(module);
1356                        
1357                        if (!isEmptyHull) {
1358                                linkFleetMemberEntryToRelated(module, moduleMember, false);
1359                        }
1360                }
1361                return result;
1362        }

1621        public static void sortSkillsCategory() {
1622                CodexEntryPlugin skills = getEntry(CAT_SKILLS);
1623                Collections.sort(skills.getChildren(), new Comparator<CodexEntryPlugin>() {
1624                        @Override
1625                        public int compare(CodexEntryPlugin o1, CodexEntryPlugin o2) {
1626                                SkillSpecAPI s1 = null;
1627                                SkillSpecAPI s2 = null;
1628                                if (o1.getParam() instanceof SkillSpecAPI) {
1629                                        s1 = (SkillSpecAPI) o1.getParam();
1630                                }
1631                                if (o2.getParam() instanceof SkillSpecAPI) {
1632                                        s2 = (SkillSpecAPI) o2.getParam();
1633                                }
1634                                if (s1 != null && s2 == null) return Integer.MIN_VALUE;
1635                                if (s2 != null && s1 == null) return Integer.MAX_VALUE;
1636                                if (s1 == null && s2 == null) return o1.getTitle().compareTo(o2.getTitle());
1637                                
1638                                int tier1 = 0;
1639                                int tier2 = 0;
1640                                if (s1.hasTag(Skills.TAG_AI_CORE_ONLY)) tier1 = 5;
1641                                if (s2.hasTag(Skills.TAG_AI_CORE_ONLY)) tier2 = 5;
1642                                
1643                                if (tier1 != tier2) return tier1 - tier2;
1644                                
1645                                int diff = s1.getGoverningAptitudeOrder() - s2.getGoverningAptitudeOrder();
1646                                if (diff != 0) return diff;
1647                                
1648                                return (int) Math.signum(s1.getOrder() - s2.getOrder());
1649                        }
1650                });
1651        }

1659                        if ((spec.getAIHints().contains(AIHints.SYSTEM) || spec.getType() == WeaponType.SYSTEM) &&
1660                                        !(spec.getAIHints().contains(AIHints.SHOW_IN_CODEX) ||
1661                                                        spec.hasTag(Tags.SHOW_IN_CODEX))) {
1662                                continue;

1675                                                        info.addPara(size + " " + type.getDisplayName().toLowerCase() + " weapon", Misc.getGrayColor(), 0f);
1676                                                        //info.addPara("Weapon", Misc.getGrayColor(), 0f);

1678                                        }
1679
1680                                        @Override
1681                                        public boolean matchesTags(Set<String> tags) {
1682                                                WeaponSize size = spec.getSize();
1683                                                
1684                                                String sizeTag = null;
1685                                                if (size == WeaponSize.SMALL) sizeTag = SMALL;
1686                                                if (size == WeaponSize.MEDIUM) sizeTag = MEDIUM;
1687                                                if (size == WeaponSize.LARGE) sizeTag = LARGE;
1688                                                if (spec.getAIHints().contains(AIHints.SYSTEM) && 
1689                                                                spec.getPrimaryRoleStr() != null &&
1690                                                                spec.getPrimaryRoleStr() != null && 
1691                                                                spec.getPrimaryRoleStr().endsWith("(Fighter)")) {
1692                                                        sizeTag = FIGHTER_WEAPON;
1693                                                }
1694                                                
1695                                                if (sizeTag != null && !tags.contains(sizeTag)) return false;
1696                                                
1697                                                String damTypeTag = null;
1698                                                DamageType type = spec.getDamageType();
1699                                                if (type == DamageType.HIGH_EXPLOSIVE) damTypeTag = HIGH_EXPLOSIVE;
1700                                                if (type == DamageType.KINETIC) damTypeTag = KINETIC;
1701                                                if (type == DamageType.ENERGY) damTypeTag = DAM_ENERGY;
1702                                                if (type == DamageType.FRAGMENTATION) damTypeTag = FRAGMENTATION;
1703                                                if (type == DamageType.OTHER) damTypeTag = OTHER;
1704                                                if (damTypeTag != null && !tags.contains(damTypeTag)) return false;
1705                                                
1706                                                String m = spec.getManufacturer();
1707                                                if (m != null && !tags.contains(m) && !tags.contains(ALL_TECHS)) return false;
1708                                                
1709                                                
1710                                                if (spec.getMountType() == WeaponType.HYBRID && tags.contains(HYBRID)) return true;
1711                                                if (spec.getMountType() == WeaponType.COMPOSITE && tags.contains(COMPOSITE)) return true;
1712                                                if (spec.getMountType() == WeaponType.SYNERGY && tags.contains(SYNERGY)) return true;
1713                                                if (spec.getMountType() == WeaponType.UNIVERSAL && tags.contains(UNIVERSAL)) return true;
1714                                                if (spec.isBeam() && tags.contains(BEAM)) return true;
1715                                                
1716                                                if (spec.getType() == WeaponType.BALLISTIC && !tags.contains(BALLISTIC)) return false;
1717                                                if (spec.getType() == WeaponType.MISSILE && !tags.contains(MISSILE)) return false;
1718                                                if (spec.getType() == WeaponType.ENERGY && !tags.contains(ENERGY)) return false;
1719                                                
1720                                                return true;
1721                                        }
1722                                        
1723                                        @Override
1724                                        public Set<String> getUnlockRelatedTags() {
1725                                                return spec.getTags();
1726                                        }
1727                                        
1728                                        @Override
1729                                        public boolean isUnlockedIfRequiresUnlock() {
1730                                                return SharedUnlockData.get().isPlayerAwareOfWeapon(spec.getWeaponId());
1731                                        }
1732                                        
1733                        };
1734                        parent.addChild(curr);
1735                }

2842        public static void makeRelated(CodexEntryPlugin ... plugins) {
2843                for (CodexEntryPlugin one : plugins) {
2844                        for (CodexEntryPlugin two : plugins) {
2845                                if (one == two) continue;
2846                                one.addRelatedEntry(two);
2847                                two.addRelatedEntry(one);
2848                        }
2849                }
2850        }

2852                for (CodexEntryPlugin one : plugins) {
2853                        for (CodexEntryPlugin two : plugins) {
2854                                if (one == two) continue;

2860        public static void makeRelated(String ... ids) {
2861                for (String id1 : ids) {
2862                        CodexEntryPlugin one = getEntry(id1);
2863                        if (one == null) continue;
2864                        for (String id2 : ids) {
2865                                if (id1 == id2) continue;
2866                                CodexEntryPlugin two = getEntry(id2);
2867                                if (two == null) continue;
2868                                one.addRelatedEntry(two);
2869                                two.addRelatedEntry(one);
2870                        }
2871                }
2872        }
2873        public static void makeUnrelated(String ... ids) {
2874                for (String id1 : ids) {
2875                        CodexEntryPlugin one = getEntry(id1);
2876                        if (one == null) continue;
2877                        for (String id2 : ids) {
2878                                if (id1 == id2) continue;
2879                                CodexEntryPlugin two = getEntry(id2);
2880                                if (two == null) continue;
2881                                one.removeRelatedEntry(two);
2882                                two.removeRelatedEntry(one);
2883                        }
2884                }
2885        }

3013        /**
3014         * Returns a list because it could be a station or a ship with modules.
3015         * @param member
3016         * @return
3017         */
3018        public static List<CodexEntryPlugin> createTempFleetMemberEntry(FleetMemberAPI member) {
3019                ShipHullSpecAPI spec = member.getHullSpec();
3020                ShipVariantAPI variant = member.getVariant();
3021                String entryId = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
3022                
3023                boolean station = spec.getHints().contains(ShipTypeHints.STATION);
3024                boolean limited = variant.hasTag(Tags.SHIP_LIMITED_TOOLTIP);
3025                if (!SharedUnlockData.get().isPlayerAwareOfShip(variant.getHullSpec().getRestoredToHullId())) {
3026                        limited |= variant.hasTag(Tags.LIMITED_TOOLTIP_IF_LOCKED);
3027                        limited |= member.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.LIMITED_TOOLTIP_IF_LOCKED);
3028                }
3029                boolean limited2 = limited;
3030                
3031                
3032                Description desc = Global.getSettings().getDescription(spec.getDescriptionId(), Type.SHIP);
3033                String entryName = variant.getFullDesignationWithHullNameForShip();
3034                if (!station && member.getShipName() != null && !member.getShipName().isBlank() && !member.isFighterWing()) {
3035                        entryName = member.getShipName() + ", " + entryName;
3036                }
3037                if (limited) entryName = desc.getText2();
3038                
3039                CodexEntryV2 entry = new CodexEntryV2(entryId, entryName, null, member) {
3040                                @Override
3041                                public void createTitleForList(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, ListMode mode) {
3042                                        //info.addPara(spec.getHullName(), Misc.getBasePlayerColor(), 0f);
3043                                        //info.addPara(member.getShipName() + " (" + spec.getHullName() + ")", Misc.getBasePlayerColor(), 0f);
3044                                        String name = member.getShipName();
3045                                        if (name == null || name.isBlank()) {
3046                                                name = spec.getHullName();
3047                                        }
3048                                        info.addPara(name, Misc.getBasePlayerColor(), 0f);
3049                                        if (limited2) {
3050                                                info.addPara(Misc.ucFirst(desc.getText2().toLowerCase()), Misc.getGrayColor(), 0f);
3051                                        } else if (spec.hasDesignation() && !spec.getDesignation().equals(spec.getHullName())) {
3052                                                //info.addPara(Misc.ucFirst(variant.getFullDesignationForShip().toLowerCase()), Misc.getGrayColor(), 0f);
3053                                                //info.addPara(Misc.ucFirst(spec.getHullNameWithDashClass().toLowerCase()), Misc.getGrayColor(), 0f);
3054                                                info.addPara(Misc.ucFirst(variant.getFullDesignationForShip().toLowerCase()), Misc.getGrayColor(), 0f);
3055                                        } else if (spec.getHints().contains(ShipTypeHints.STATION)) {
3056                                                info.addPara("Station", Misc.getGrayColor(), 0f);
3057                                        } else if (spec.getHints().contains(ShipTypeHints.MODULE)) {
3058                                                info.addPara("Module", Misc.getGrayColor(), 0f);
3059                                        }
3060                                }
3061                                @Override
3062                                public boolean matchesTags(Set<String> tags) {
3063                                        return false;
3064                                }
3065                                @Override
3066                                public boolean isVisible() {
3067                                        // only shows up in related lists because not added to its own parent category
3068                                        return true;
3069                                }
3070                                @Override
3071                                public boolean isLocked() {
3072                                        return false;
3073                                }
3074                };
3075                
3076                linkFleetMemberEntryToRelated(entry, member, true);
3077                
3078                CodexEntryPlugin parent = getEntry(CAT_SHIPS);
3079                if (station) parent = getEntry(CAT_STATIONS);
3080                entry.setParent(parent);
3081                
3082                List<CodexEntryPlugin> result = new ArrayList<>();
3083                result.add(entry);
3084                
3085                List<CodexEntryPlugin> modules = addModulesForVariant(member.getVariant(), false, entry, parent);
3086                result.addAll(modules);
3087                
3088                return result;
3089                
3090        }

3092        /**
3093         * This method assumes the entry is a specific fleet member with a loadout, and NOT an empty hull.
3094         * Meaning, this entry was added on the fly such as e.g. from a tooltip of a fleet member.
3095         * The linking for empty hull entries is done in the linkRelatedEntries() method.
3096         * 
3097         * @param entry
3098         * @param member
3099         * @param parentOfModuleEntry
3100         * @param parentOfModule
3101         */
3102        public static void linkFleetMemberEntryToRelated(CodexEntryPlugin entry, 
3103                                FleetMemberAPI member, boolean linkCaptainSkills) {
3104                ShipHullSpecAPI spec = member.getHullSpec();
3105                ShipVariantAPI variant = member.getVariant();
3106                CodexEntryPlugin hullEntry = getEntry(getFleetMemberEntryId(member));
3107                entry.addRelatedEntry(hullEntry);
3108                if (hullEntry != null) {
3109                        for (CodexEntryPlugin rel : hullEntry.getRelatedEntries()) {
3110                                if (rel.hasTag(TAG_EMPTY_MODULE)) continue;
3111//                              if (rel.getId().equals("codex_hull_station3")) {
3112//                                      System.out.println("Relid: " + rel.getId());
3113//                              }
3114                                // skip all entries linking modules back to their empty hull
3115                                // since we'll be linking to a non-empty hull
3116                                // or, if we're viewing a module directly, don't link to parent hull at all
3117                                // if getParam2() is a fleet member, we don't want to link to it
3118                                if (rel.getParam2() instanceof FleetMemberAPI) {
3119                                        continue;
3120//                                      FleetMemberAPI otherMember = (FleetMemberAPI) rel.getParam2();
3121//                                      String h1 = getFleetMemberBaseHullId(otherMember);
3122//                                      String h2 = getFleetMemberBaseHullId(parentOfModule);
3123//                                      if (h1.equals(h2)) continue;
3124                                }
3125                                entry.addRelatedEntry(rel);
3126                                rel.addRelatedEntry(entry);
3127                        }
3128                }
3129                
3130                String sysId = spec.getShipSystemId();
3131                if (sysId != null && !sysId.isBlank()) {
3132                        String key = getShipSystemEntryId(sysId);
3133                        CodexEntryPlugin sys = getEntry(key);
3134                        if (sys != null) {
3135                                sys.addRelatedEntry(entry);
3136                                entry.addRelatedEntry(sys);
3137                        
3138                                // link ship systems and ships with their drones, if any
3139                                if (sys.getParam() instanceof ShipSystemSpecAPI) {
3140                                        ShipSystemSpecAPI sysSpec = (ShipSystemSpecAPI) sys.getParam();
3141                                        if (sysSpec.getDroneVariant() != null) {
3142                                                ShipVariantAPI drone = Global.getSettings().getVariant(sysSpec.getDroneVariant());
3143                                                if (drone != null) {
3144                                                        String droneHullId = getBaseHullId(drone.getHullSpec());
3145                                                        String droneEntryId = getShipEntryId(droneHullId);
3146                                                        makeRelated(entry.getId(), droneEntryId);
3147                                                        makeRelated(sys.getId(), droneEntryId);
3148                                                }
3149                                        }
3150                                }
3151                        }
3152                }
3153                
3154                
3155                for (String slotId : variant.getFittedWeaponSlots()) {
3156                        String wid = variant.getWeaponId(slotId);
3157                        CodexEntryPlugin other = getEntry(getWeaponEntryId(wid));
3158                        if (other != null) {
3159                                entry.addRelatedEntry(other);
3160                                other.addRelatedEntry(entry);
3161                        }
3162                }
3163                for (String wingId : variant.getFittedWings()) {
3164                        CodexEntryPlugin other = getEntry(getFighterEntryId(wingId));
3165                        if (other != null) {
3166                                entry.addRelatedEntry(other);
3167                                other.addRelatedEntry(entry);
3168                        }
3169                }
3170                for (String hullmodId : variant.getHullMods()) {
3171                        CodexEntryPlugin other = getEntry(getHullmodEntryId(hullmodId));
3172                        if (other != null) {
3173                                entry.addRelatedEntry(other);
3174                                other.addRelatedEntry(entry);
3175                        }
3176                }
3177                
3178                if (linkCaptainSkills && member.getCaptain() != null && !member.getCaptain().isDefault()) {
3179                        for (SkillLevelAPI sl : member.getCaptain().getStats().getSkillsCopy()) {
3180                                if (sl.getLevel() > 0 && sl.getSkill().isCombatOfficerSkill()) {
3181                                        CodexEntryPlugin other = getEntry(getSkillEntryId(sl.getSkill().getId()));
3182                                        if (other != null) {
3183                                                entry.addRelatedEntry(other);
3184                                                other.addRelatedEntry(entry);
3185                                        }
3186                                }
3187                        }
3188                }
3189        }

3201        public static void unlinkAndRemoveTempEntry(CodexEntryPlugin entry) {
3202                if (entry == null) return;
3203                for (CodexEntryPlugin rel : entry.getRelatedEntries()) {
3204                        rel.removeRelatedEntry(entry.getId());
3205                        entry.removeRelatedEntry(rel.getId());
3206                }
3207                ENTRIES.remove(entry.getId());
3208                
3209                Set<String> remove = new LinkedHashSet<>();
3210                for (String id : SEEN_STATION_MODULES.keySet()) {
3211                        if (SEEN_STATION_MODULES.get(id) == entry) {
3212                                remove.add(id);
3213                        }
3214                }
3215                for (String id : remove) {
3216                        SEEN_STATION_MODULES.remove(id);
3217                }
3218                
3219                if (entry.getParent() != null) {
3220                        entry.getParent().getChildren().remove(entry);
3221                }
3222        }
